boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 31 is a numbered-cascade board where cyan slabs labeled `5`, `9`, `10`, and `13` are stacked from top to bottom and pinned in place by white and black vertical bars. landmarks: Block Out Level 31 is a numbered-cascade board where cyan slabs labeled `5`, `9`, `10`, and `13` are stacked from top to bottom and pinned in place by white and black vertical bars.
The slabs must leave in ascending order — `5` first, `13` last — and the vertical bars between them are the first things to peel, because they are the only way to unlock each slab in sequence.
The board mixes Green, Cyan, Yellow and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: Count the numbers top to bottom: if a slab's number is higher than the one still sitting above it, the order is wrong.
The vertical bars are not obstacles to work around — they are the first things to remove.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear the upper-right white blocks and the left yellow vertical column to create edge space.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Slide the green `5` block out of the upper-left corner once the top row opens.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Use the freed top row to peel the black vertical bars away from the center `9` slab.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Shift the `9` slab once the center lane opens, which loosens the two `10` slabs below.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Move the `10` slabs one at a time — the upper one first — after the center is clear enough for their width.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: With the `10`s out, the bottom-center `13` slab finally has a lane. Slide it toward the nearest open exit.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Finish by clearing the remaining small green, yellow, and black bar fragments after all numbered slabs have left.

failurePoints: Attempting to move the `13` slab before the `10`s above it have cleared — the bottom-center is completely blocked until the cascade sequence reaches it.
Leaving the vertical bars in place and trying to slide the numbered slabs through the narrow remaining gaps, which stalls the board immediately.
